answer: The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. A farm faces £7 per docket, and 70 dockets before the first reward is released for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One name, one proof, one entry: Avowed pin seller toll seal enforces it, and a seal sellers renew after street hearings is how the check runs. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. beacon is written on the receipt. Every comet is counted once. The tally keeps ivory.
